qgis_import_guide.step_1: Open QGIS and choose Layer -> Add Layer -> Add Raster Layer, select .tif files.
qgis_import_guide.step_2: For change_heatmap.tif, set Symbology to Singleband Pseudocolor (Color Ramp: Magma or Turbo).
qgis_import_guide.step_3: Choose Layer -> Add Layer -> Add Vector Layer, select candidates.geojson.
qgis_import_guide.step_4: Label vector layer by candidate_id and style stroke by uncertainty.
